question: Where is coffee grown, and how much does Viet Nam grow?
answer:
Robusta coffee is grown across 79 countries reporting to FAOSTAT, with a total world harvested area of 12,353,073 ha [S1]. The largest harvested areas are in Brazil (1,905,536 ha), Indonesia (1,267,388 ha), Colombia (840,479 ha), Ethiopia (833,661 ha), and Uganda (832,866 ha), based on means from 2022 to 2024 [S1]. 

Viet Nam has a harvested area of 667,148 ha (mean of 2022-2024), representing the 7th largest harvested area in these statistics [S1]. Viet Nam is the world's largest exporter of robusta coffee, accounting for over 40% of total production [S2].
